name: Atoms, ions and photons
blurb: Tweezer arrays, trapped ions, and light — the platforms built from single particles.

touchstones.text: neutral atom tweezer arrays and Rydberg blockade entangling gates
trapped-ion gates, shuttling and QCCD architectures
photonic qubits, linear-optical computing and boson sampling
cavity QED, atom-photon interfaces and quantum networks
quantum memories and repeaters for long-distance links
mid-circuit measurement, atom loss and erasure conversion
laser and motional-mode error budgets, heating and crosstalk
